title: Indian Army Agniveer GD Full Length Mock Test 06 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for Indian Army Agniveer GD (CEE). 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Advanced challenging questions based on latest pattern.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions (General Knowledge 25, General Science 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning 25).
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Official CEE GD pattern 50 questions ka hota hai; yeh extended full-length practice set hai.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which Act transferred the administration of India from the East India Company to the British Crown?
questions.explanation: After the Revolt of 1857, the Government of India Act 1858 ended Company rule and placed India under the Crown.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: Robert Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah at Plassey in 1757, a turning point in British expansion in Bengal.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who was the first Indian Governor-General of independent India?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari succeeded Lord Mountbatten in June 1948 as the first Indian Governor-General.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Doctrine of Lapse is associated with which Governor-General?
questions.explanation: Lord Dalhousie used the Doctrine of Lapse to annex states without a natural male heir.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which movement was launched after the failure of the Cripps Mission?
questions.explanation: After Cripps Mission (1942) failed, Congress launched Quit India on 8 August 1942.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
questions.explanation: The Kosi frequently changes course and floods north Bihar, hence the name.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states; Odisha lies south of it.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which is the largest salt-water lake in India?
questions.explanation: Chilika in Odisha is India's largest coastal lagoon/salt-water lake.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Duncan Passage lies between which islands?
questions.explanation: Duncan Passage separates South Andaman from Little Andaman.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which soil type is most suitable for cotton cultivation in India?
questions.explanation: Black (regur) soils of the Deccan retain moisture and suit cotton.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the amendment procedure?
questions.explanation: Article 368 lays down the procedure for constitutional amendments.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The idea of the Concurrent List in the Indian Constitution is borrowed from which country?
questions.explanation: The Concurrent List is modelled on the Australian Constitution.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who appoints the Chief Election Commissioner of India?
questions.explanation: The President appoints the CEC and other Election Commissioners.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment is related to which of the following?
questions.explanation: The 73rd Amendment (1992) gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: Article 80 allows the President to nominate 12 members to the Rajya Sabha.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: NITI Aayog replaced which institution?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog was set up on 1 January 2015 replacing the Planning Commission.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which of the following is a direct tax?
questions.explanation: Income tax is levied directly on persons/entities; GST and customs are indirect.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Exercise Yudh Abhyas is a joint military exercise between India and which country?
questions.explanation: Yudh Abhyas is the Indo-US army exercise series.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The headquarters of the Indian Army's Eastern Command is located at?
questions.explanation: Eastern Command HQ is at Fort William, Kolkata.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which regiment is known as the 'Bravest of the Brave'?
questions.explanation: The Grenadiers are widely referred to in defence exam material as Bravest of the Brave due to high gallantry awards.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Param Vir Chakra was first awarded for action in which war?
questions.explanation: The first PVCs were awarded for operations in the 1947-48 Kashmir war.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The term 'Lona' is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: In kabaddi, a lona is when a team gets all opponents out and scores extra points.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The festival of 'Hornbill' is celebrated in which state?
questions.explanation: The Hornbill Festival is held annually in Nagaland.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Project Tiger was launched in which year?
questions.explanation: Project Tiger was launched on 1 April 1973.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Strait of Hormuz connects the Persian Gulf with which water body?
questions.explanation: Hormuz links the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman.

questions.explanation: Candela (cd) is the SI base unit of luminous intensity.

questions.subject: General Science

questions.explanation: Rockets move forward by expelling gases backward (action-reaction).

questions.subject: General Science

questions.explanation: Nitrogen constitutes about 78% of dry air.

questions.subject: General Science

questions.subject: General Science

questions.explanation: A generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.

questions.subject: General Science

questions.explanation: Isotopes have the same atomic number (protons) but different mass numbers.

questions.subject: General Science

questions.subject: General Science

questions.subject: General Science

questions.subject: General Science

questions.explanation: India uses 50 Hz alternating current.

questions.subject: General Science

questions.explanation: SF6 has an extremely high 100-year GWP.

questions.explanation: Ohm's law holds for ohmic conductors when temperature is constant.
